notes.title: Update 10
notes.content: The big optimization has been made, and the problem that the game may crash after long time playing should no longer appear.

notes.title: Update 9
notes.content: The game settings interface has now added a "low quality" option. Checking it can significantly improve FPS, which brings about a 5 FPS boost on my computer.

notes.title: New map (update 8)
notes.content:
The Early Access is coming to an end and 3 new maps have been updated as planned.

1. Add a new map: Floating Party.

2. Streamline the car driving system and now it can accelerate indefinitely.

3. Optimize the UI.

4. Remove all map acceleration devices.

5. Update the map cover image.

notes.title: New Map (Update 7)
notes.content:
1. Add a new map Skyline.

2. Optimize the timing system.

3. Optimize the sound system.

4. Optimize the Overpass map.

5. Optimize the Hive map.

6. Optimize the Playground map.

7. Optimize the DEMO version.

notes.title: Update 6
notes.content:
1. Now the two long maps of the Night City and the Overpass have added a lot of acceleration devices. They can not only accelerate but also replenish fuel, which greatly shortens the time required to complete the map and speeds up the overall rhythm of the game.

2. Optimize the game.

notes.title: New themes, optimization (update 5)
notes.content:
1, The Night City map adds three new themes.

2, Hive map lighting optimization.

3, game performance optimization.

4, UI update.

notes.title: New themes, driving system improvements (Update 4)
notes.content:
1. Improve the driving system. Now a Instantaneous thrust is added to the acceleration start state.

2. The Overpass map adds 2 new themes: dusk, night.

3. Add a customization option: Bloom adjustment.

4. Add a customization option: UI hidden.

5. Optimize the rear lights of the car.

6. Optimize the map of the Night City and enhance road materials..

7. Optimize the hive map.

8. Optimize camera follow.

notes.title: New map! (Update 3)
notes.content:
1, Map name - Hive

2, UI update, beautification.

The next patch will focuses on new themes.

notes.title: Added theme system! (Update 2)
notes.content:
1.The car control system has been improved, and the control of the car is now more heavy and stable.

2.Added theme system! The night sun has a new green theme. There will be more themes in the future.

3.Added 'Next Music' feature. (N key)

4.Shift & Space switching has been added to the title's settings menu.

5.The trophy icon has been added to the leaderboard.

6.Optimized instructions.

7.Optimized the finish line effect.

8.Optimized for the acceleration light effect.

9.Optimized the 'Night Sun' map.

10.Added a video tutorial (on the Steam page).

notes.title: Update 1
notes.content:
If you can't open the menu via ESC in the map (which may happen with Win8), please press the “O” button in the setup menu of the home page and then start the Old Control mode, which will solve the above problem.

1. Added Turkish.

2. A lot of guide plates have been added to the track of the playground map.

3. Added crash sound.

4. Optimized sound effects and music.

5. Optimized the leaderboard display.

6. Optimized translation.
